# Content Authoring UX Checklist: Standalone pages for doncoleman.ca

**Purpose**: Validate requirements for adding and editing pages from one file, and for clear build errors.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## One-File Authoring

- [ ] CHK001 - Is "the only change needed" defined precisely enough to exclude route, list, config and image-registry edits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the rules for deriving an address from file name and nested folders fully specified, including index files and the home page mapping? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are file-name character rules (case, spaces, underscores, dots) defined, or is behaviour for unusual names a gap? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the location of page images relative to the page file, and how paths are written, specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is "both or neither" for image plus alt text defined for both sharing and feature images with the same error behaviour? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the documented set of sections required to include an example of each and the required and optional fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Build Errors

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "plain language" for error messages defined with content criteria (file path, setting or section, what is wrong, how to fix)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is every FR-007 failure class mapped to exactly one expected message shape, so each is testable? [Traceability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the behaviour for multiple errors in one build specified (first only versus all reported)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are errors inside section markup (unknown section, missing attribute) required to identify the location within the file, not only the file? [Clarity, Spec §US5-3]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are unknown-setting errors required to suggest the nearest valid setting, or is that explicitly out of scope? [Ambiguity, Spec §US5-2]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the empty-body rule defined (whitespace only, sections only, draft notice only)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are error requirements consistent between local build, CI and preview builds? [Consistency, Spec §US5-5, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the edit-one-page scenario ("only that page's output changes") defined with a measurable criterion? [Measurability, Spec §US3-5]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are draft-flag requirements clear on how to remove the notice and what else the flag affects (nothing else)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is guidance for description length documented for Don where it is not enforced, and where it lives? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
